WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at)::date AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS gross_revenue
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  to_char(month, 'YYYY-MM') AS yyyy_mm,
  gross_revenue,
  gross_revenue - LAG(gross_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS mo_increase
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

FROM public.order_items oi
JOIN public.inventory_items ii ON ii.id = oi.inventory_item_id
JOIN public.distribution_centers dc ON dc.id = ii.product_distribution_center_id
WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01'
  AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY dc.name
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC

SELECT ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'Purchase' THEN session_id END)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT session_id), 0))::numeric, 4) AS conversion_rate FROM public.events WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'

WITH jan_users AS (
    SELECT id, created_at
    FROM public.users
    WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2024-02-01'
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT u.id AS user_id,
           oi.order_id,
           MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time,
           u.created_at AS user_created_at
    FROM jan_users u
    JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    GROUP BY u.id, oi.order_id, u.created_at
),
qualified_users AS (
    SELECT user_id
    FROM user_orders
    WHERE order_time >= user_created_at
      AND order_time < user_created_at + INTERVAL '90 days'
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualified_users)::double precision 
    / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jan_users) AS share

SELECT u.traffic_source,
       ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT u.id), 0))::numeric, 2) AS gross_revenue_per_user
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
    AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY u.traffic_source
ORDER BY gross_revenue_per_user DESC

SELECT ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - created_at)) / 3600))::numeric, 2) AS median_hours
FROM public.order_items
WHERE status = 'Complete'
  AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
  AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL

       COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS new_users,
       ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END))::numeric, 2) AS total_net_revenue
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
    AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01'
    AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01'

WITH facebook_users AS (
    SELECT id FROM users 
    WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook' 
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01' 
    AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_non_cancelled_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
    FROM order_items oi
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND oi.user_id IN (SELECT id FROM facebook_users)
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ordered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
    FROM user_non_cancelled_orders
),
first_two AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN order_time END) AS first_order,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN order_time END) AS second_order
    FROM ordered_orders
    WHERE rn IN (1, 2)
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
)
SELECT 
    ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (second_order - first_order)) / 86400))::numeric, 2) AS median_days
FROM first_two

WITH user_acquisition AS (
    SELECT 
        u.id AS user_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', u.created_at) AS acquisition_month,
        u.created_at AS user_created_at
    FROM public.users u
    WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders_check AS (
    SELECT 
        ua.user_id,
        ua.acquisition_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) > 0 AS has_order
    FROM user_acquisition ua
    LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi 
        ON oi.user_id = ua.user_id
        AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
        AND oi.created_at >= ua.user_created_at
        AND oi.created_at < ua.user_created_at + INTERVAL '30 days'
    GROUP BY ua.user_id, ua.acquisition_month
)
SELECT 
    TO_CHAR(acquisition_month, 'YYYY-MM') AS acquisition_month,
    ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_order)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::double precision)::numeric, 4) AS share
FROM user_orders_check
GROUP BY acquisition_month
ORDER BY share DESC

WITH facebook_users AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM public.users
    WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook'
      AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN facebook_users fu ON fu.id = oi.user_id
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_id,
        order_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS order_rank
    FROM user_orders
),
second_third AS (
    SELECT 
        r1.user_id,
        r1.order_time AS second_order_time,
        r2.order_time AS third_order_time,
        EXTRACT(DAY FROM (r2.order_time - r1.order_time)) AS days_between
    FROM ranked_orders r1
    JOIN ranked_orders r2 ON r1.user_id = r2.user_id 
        AND r1.order_rank = 2 
        AND r2.order_rank = 3
)
SELECT 
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_between) AS median_days
FROM second_third

WITH user_gross_spend AS (
  SELECT user_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS gross_spend
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT ROUND((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gross_spend))::numeric, 2) AS p90_gross_spend
FROM user_gross_spend

WITH user_orders AS (
    SELECT u.id AS user_id
    FROM public.users u
    WHERE u.created_at >= '2024-01-01' 
      AND u.created_at < '2025-01-01'
      AND u.traffic_source = 'Organic'
),
user_order_times AS (
    SELECT 
        uo.user_id,
        oi.order_id,
        MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
    FROM user_orders uo
    JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = uo.user_id
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    GROUP BY uo.user_id, oi.order_id
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_id,
        order_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
    FROM user_order_times
),
first_second AS (
    SELECT 
        f.user_id,
        f.order_time AS first_order_time,
        s.order_time AS second_order_time,
        EXTRACT(DAY FROM (s.order_time - f.order_time)) AS days_between
    FROM ranked_orders f
    JOIN ranked_orders s ON f.user_id = s.user_id AND f.rn = 1 AND s.rn = 2
)
SELECT 
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_between) AS median_days
FROM first_second

WITH order_values AS (
  SELECT 
    order_id,
    user_id,
    MIN(created_at) AS order_time,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS order_value
  FROM public.order_items
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY order_id, user_id
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN status <> 'Cancelled' THEN sale_price ELSE 0 END) > 0
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    order_id,
    user_id,
    order_value,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time, order_id) AS order_rank
  FROM order_values
),
first_orders AS (
  SELECT order_value FROM ranked_orders WHERE order_rank = 1
),
repeat_orders AS (
  SELECT order_value FROM ranked_orders WHERE order_rank > 1
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(((SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FROM first_orders) - 
         (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) FROM repeat_orders))::numeric, 2) AS difference

WITH order_times AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_id,
        MIN(created_at) AS order_time
    FROM public.order_items
    WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY user_id, order_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Cancelled') > 0
),
ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        order_id,
        order_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
    FROM order_times
),
first_second AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN order_time END) AS first_order_time,
        MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN order_time END) AS second_order_time
    FROM ranked_orders
    WHERE rn <= 2
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
)
SELECT 
    ROUND((percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (second_order_time - first_order_time)) / 86400.0))::numeric, 2) AS days_95th_percentile
FROM first_second

WITH search_users AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM public.users
    WHERE traffic_source = 'Search'
      AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
      AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
user_orders AS (
    SELECT oi.user_id, oi.order_id, MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_time
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN search_users su ON su.id = oi.user_id
    WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
user_order_ranks AS (
    SELECT user_id, order_time,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY order_time) AS rn
    FROM user_orders
),
first_two AS (
    SELECT user_id,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN order_time END) AS first_order_time,
           MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN order_time END) AS second_order_time
    FROM user_order_ranks
    WHERE rn IN (1, 2)
    GROUP BY user_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
),
day_diffs AS (
    SELECT (second_order_time::date - first_order_time::date) AS days_between
    FROM first_two
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_between) AS median_days
FROM day_diffs
